reasons: Status is 'compliant' and, consistent with that, no redline or comment was proposed — the rendered text is identical to the original paragraphs.

Section 14.3 is the only liquidated damages provision and it runs in favour of Ono (our party as Licensee/Customer): it is triggered by Array's failure or data falsification and gives Ono relief from diligence obligations plus a reduced royalty rate. The rule expressly treats LDs payable to the Customer as compliant and not to be redlined.

No Customer-payable penalty, minimum termination fee or early-termination fee was identified; Section 7.1's late-payment interest is ordinary commercial interest and is properly excluded from penalty treatment.

Rationale accurately cites the supporting paragraphs (p0668/p0671, p0463) and correctly concludes the preferred position (no Customer-payable LD) is met; retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
